#Convert to NA
```{r}

WVS |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(.x < 0, NA, .x)))
```



#Convert data types

```{r}
WVS <- WVS |> 
  mutate(across(-c(Q262,Q270, Q274),factor))
```

#Response variable (Bar)

```{r}

WVS |>
  filter(!is.na(Q106)) |>
  mutate(Q106 = factor(Q106, levels = 1:10)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Q106)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = after_stat(count / sum(count))),
           fill = "steelblue", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Views on Income Equality and Income Differences",
    subtitle = "Q106: 1 = incomes more equal; 10 = larger income differences",
    x = "Response scale",
    y = "Percentage of respondents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

#Respondent profile

```{r}
#Age distribution

mean_age <- mean(WVS2$Q262, na.rm = TRUE)
median_age <- median(WVS2$Q262, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(WVS2, aes(x = Q262)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 5,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean_age, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_age, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.7) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(15, 90)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(15, 90, by = 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution of Respondents",
    subtitle = paste0("Mean = ", round(mean_age, 1), ", Median = ", round(median_age, 1)),
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Number of respondents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```


```{r}
profile_cat <- WVS |>
  dplyr::select(Q260, Q273, Q275R, Q279, Q289, Q288R) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(everything(), as.character)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    variable = dplyr::recode(
      variable,
      Q260 = "Sex",
      Q273 = "Marital status",
      Q275R = "Education",
      Q279 = "Employment",
      Q289 = "Religion",
      Q288R = "Income"
    )
  )

p_cat <- ggplot(profile_cat, aes(x = forcats::fct_infreq(value))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Respondent Profile", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_cat

```

#Create plotting function [Boxplot]

```{r}

boxplot_Q106 <- function(data, yvar, xvar, ylab, xlab, title){
  
  ggplot(data |> filter(!is.na(.data[[xvar]]), !is.na(.data[[yvar]])) |> mutate(across(all_of(yvar), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x)))), 
         aes(x=.data[[xvar]], y=.data[[yvar]])) +
    geom_boxplot(
      fill="steelblue",
      width= 0.45,
      alpha= 0.55,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width=0.12,
      alpha=0.15, 
      size=1,
      height=0
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=1:10, limits=c(1,10)) +
    labs(
      title=title,
      x=xlab,
      y=ylab
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
}

```

```{r}
bp_religous <- boxplot_Q106(WVS,"Q106", "Q289", "Q106","Religious denominations", "Q106 by Religious denominations")

bp_earner <- boxplot_Q106(WVS,"Q106", "Q285", "Q106","Are you the chief wage earner in your house", "Q106 by Are you the chief wage earner in your house")

bp_savings <- boxplot_Q106(WVS,"Q106", "Q286", "Q106","Family savings during past year", "Q106 by Family savings during past year")

bp_class <- boxplot_Q106(WVS,"Q106", "Q287", "Q106","Social class", "Q106 by Social class")
```

#Recode Q290 into fewer groups
```{r}

WVS <- WVS %>%
  mutate(
    Q290_recode = case_when(
      Q290_recode %in% c(
        "PH: Tagalog", "PH: Imus", "PH: Las Piñas",
        "PH: Malolos", "PH: Manila", "PH: Marikina", "PH: Muntinlupa",
        "PH: Nakar", "PH: Navotas", "PH: Parañaque", "PH: Pasig", "PH: Pili", "PH: Romblomanon", "PH: Marinduque", "PH: Maragondon"
      ) ~ "Tagalog",
      
      Q290_recode == "PH: Ilocano" ~ "Ilocano",
      
      Q290_recode %in% c("PH: Bicolano", "PH: Naga") ~ "Bicolano",
      
      Q290_recode %in% c(
        "PH: Cebuano", "PH: Ilonggo", "PH: Masbateño", "PH: Waray",
        "PH: Surigaonon", "PH: Antique", "PH: Mindanao/Bisaya",
        "PH: Aklanon", "PH: Cantilangnon",
        "PH: Boholano", "PH: Miagao", "PH: Lapu-Lapu (Opon)", "PH: Liloan", "PH: Oroquieta", "PH: Ozamiz"
      ) ~ "Bisaya/Visayan",
      
      Q290_recode %in% c(
        "PH: Igorot", "PH: Ayangan (Kankanaey)", "PH: Tinguian Tribe",
        "PH: Belwang tribe", "PH: Matinguian Tribe", "PH: Langangilang"
      ) ~ "Cordillera/Northern Indigenous",
      
      Q290_recode %in% c(
        "PH: Yakan", "PH: Tausug", "PH: Maranao", "PH: Maguindanao",
        "PH: Samah", "PH: Sinamah", "PH: Subanin", "PH: Taga Kaulo",
        "PH: B'laan", "PH: Kamayo", "PH: Kumalarang", "PH: Labangan",
        "PH: Malapatan", "PH: Panabo"
      ) ~ "Moro/Mindanao groups",
      
      Q290_recode %in% c(
        "PH: Pangasinense", "PH: Kapampangan",
        "PH: Sambal", "PH: Mangyan", "PH: Chavacano", 
         "PH: Padre Burgos", "PH: Leon",
         "PH: Lubao"
      ) ~ "Tagalog",
      
      is.na(Q290_recode) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ "Other Philippine groups"
    )
  )

WVS$Q290_recode <- factor(WVS$Q290_recode)

table(WVS$Q290_recode, useNA = "ifany")
```

#Modeling
#PO model

```{r}

WVS_model <- WVS |>
  select(Q106, Q260, Q262, Q275R, Q279, Q288R, Q287, Q273, Q290_recode, Q286) |>
  na.omit() |>
  droplevels()

#Model A: core demographic + SES
model_A <- clm(Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R, data = WVS_model, link = "logit", threshold = "flexible")

#Model B: add subjective class
model_B <- clm(Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R + Q287, data = WVS_model, link = "logit", threshold = "flexible")

#Model C: add financial coping instead of class
model_C <- clm(Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R + Q286, data = WVS_model, link = "logit", threshold = "flexible")

#Model D: add residence only
model_D <- clm(Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R + Q290_recode, data = WVS_model, link = "logit", threshold = "flexible")

#Model E: add marital status only
model_E <- clm(Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R + Q273, data = WVS_model, link = "logit", threshold = "flexible")

```


```{r}

AIC(model_A, model_B, model_C, model_D, model_E)
anova(model_A, model_B)
anova(model_A, model_C)
anova(model_A, model_D)
anova(model_A, model_E)
```

#pseudo r squared

```{r}
#library(performance)

pseudo_r2_results <- tibble(
  Model = c("model_A", "model_B", "model_C", "model_D", "model_E"),
  `Pseudo R-squared` = c(
    r2_nagelkerke(model_A),
    r2_nagelkerke(model_B),
    r2_nagelkerke(model_C),
    r2_nagelkerke(model_D),
    r2_nagelkerke(model_E)
  )
)
```


#Summary Table (Models A-E)
```{r}
#library(dplyr)
#library(tibble)
#library(flextable)
#library(officer)

# AIC table
aic_results <- AIC(model_A, model_B, model_C, model_D, model_E) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("Model") |>
  rename(
    df = df,
    AIC = AIC
  )

# BIC table
bic_results <- BIC(model_A, model_B, model_C, model_D, model_E) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("Model") |>
  rename(
    BIC = BIC
  ) |>
  select(Model, BIC)

# Model formulas
model_formulas <- tibble(
  Model = c("model_A", "model_B", "model_C", "model_D", "model_E"),
  `Model Name` = c(
    "Model A: Core demographic + SES",
    "Model B: Add subjective class",
    "Model C: Add financial coping",
    "Model D: Add ethnolinguistic group",
    "Model E: Add marital status"
  ),
  `Model Formula` = c(
    "Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R",
    "Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R + Q287",
    "Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R + Q286",
    "Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R + Q290_recode",
    "Q106 ~ Q260 + Q262 + Q275R + Q279 + Q288R + Q273"
  )
)

# Likelihood ratio test p-values versus Model A
lrt_results <- tibble(
  Model = c("model_A", "model_B", "model_C", "model_D", "model_E"),
  `p-value` = c(
    NA,
    anova(model_A, model_B)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
    anova(model_A, model_C)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
    anova(model_A, model_D)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
    anova(model_A, model_E)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
)

# Combine results
model_summary <- model_formulas |>
  left_join(aic_results, by = "Model") |>
  left_join(bic_results, by = "Model") |>
  left_join(lrt_results, by = "Model") |>
  left_join(pseudo_r2_results, by = "Model") |>
  mutate(
    AIC = round(AIC, 3),
    BIC = round(BIC, 3),
    `Pseudo R-squared` = round(`Pseudo R-squared`, 3),
    `p-value` = case_when(
      is.na(`p-value`) ~ "Reference",
      `p-value` < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(`p-value`, 3))
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    `Model Name`,
    `Model Formula`,
    df,
    AIC,
    BIC,
    `Pseudo R-squared`,
    `p-value`
  )

#model_summary

ft_model_summary <- model_summary |>
  flextable() |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  align(align = "center", part = "header") |>
  align(j = c("df", "AIC", "BIC", "Pseudo R-squared", "p-value"),
        align = "center", part = "body") |>
  align(j = c("Model Name", "Model Formula"),
        align = "left", part = "body") |>
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") |>
  padding(padding = 4, part = "all") |>
  autofit() |>
  add_footer_lines(
    "Note. AIC = Akaike Information Criterion. BIC = Bayesian Information Criterion. Pseudo R-squared refers to Nagelkerke's pseudo R-squared. The p-values are based on likelihood ratio tests comparing each expanded model with Model A. Model A serves as the reference model."
  )

save_as_docx(
  "Table 1. Summary of Candidate Cumulative Link Models" = ft_model_summary,
  path = "model_summary_table.docx"
)

ft_model_summary

```



#check PO assumption

```{r}
#Education and income have nominal effects

nominal_test(model_D)

#library(dplyr)
#library(tibble)
#library(flextable)
#library(officer)

nom_test <- nominal_test(model_D)

nom_table <- as.data.frame(nom_test) |>
  rownames_to_column("Variable") |>
  filter(Variable != "<none>") |>
  select(Variable, Df, LRT, `Pr(>Chi)`) |>
  mutate(
    Variable = recode(Variable,
      Q260 = "Q260: Sex",
      Q262 = "Q262: Age group",
      Q275R = "Q275R: Educational attainment",
      Q279 = "Q279: Employment status",
      Q288R = "Q288R: Income group",
      Q290_recode = "Q290_recode: Ethnolinguistic group"
    ),
    `Chi-square` = round(LRT, 3),
    `p-value` = case_when(
      is.na(`Pr(>Chi)`) ~ "",
      `Pr(>Chi)` < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", `Pr(>Chi)`)
    )
  ) |>
  select(Variable, Df, `Chi-square`, `p-value`)

ft_nom <- nom_table |>
  flextable() |>
  set_header_labels(
    Variable = "Variable",
    Df = "df",
    `Chi-square` = "χ²",
    `p-value` = "p-value"
  ) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  align(align = "center", part = "header") |>
  align(j = c("Df", "Chi-square", "p-value"), align = "center", part = "body") |>
  align(j = "Variable", align = "left", part = "body") |>
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") |>
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") |>
  padding(padding = 4, part = "all") |>
  autofit() |>
  add_footer_lines(
    "Note. Results are based on likelihood ratio tests for nominal effects in the cumulative link model. χ² = likelihood ratio chi-square statistic."
  )

ft_nom

save_as_docx(
  "Table 2. Tests of Nominal Effects (Model D)" = ft_nom,
  path = "nominal_effects_table.docx"
)
```

```{r}
#library(dplyr)
#library(tibble)
#library(stringr)
#library(tidyr)
#library(flextable)
#library(officer)

# =========================
# MODEL LIST
# =========================
models <- list(
  "Model D"    = model_D,
  "Model D_S1" = model_D_S1,
  "Model D_S2" = model_D_S2,
  "Model D_S3" = model_D_S3,
  "Model D_S4" = model_D_S4,
  "Model D_S5" = model_D_S5
)

# Use the base model to recover actual factor reference levels
mf <- droplevels(model.frame(model_D))

ref_levels <- list(
  Q260 = levels(mf$Q260)[1],
  Q262 = levels(mf$Q262)[1],
  Q275R = levels(mf$Q275R)[1],
  Q279 = levels(mf$Q279)[1],
  Q288R = levels(mf$Q288R)[1],
  Q290_recode = levels(mf$Q290_recode)[1]
)

# =========================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# =========================

add_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

format_cell <- function(est, se, p, digits = 3) {
  if (is.na(est)) return("")
  
  paste0(
    sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), est),
    add_stars(p),
    "\n(",
    sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), se),
    ")"
  )
}

extract_clm_part <- function(model, model_name, part = c("beta", "zeta")) {
  part <- match.arg(part)
  
  if (part == "beta") {
    est <- model$beta
    panel <- "Location"
  } else {
    est <- model$zeta
    panel <- "Log-scale"
  }
  
  if (length(est) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      term = character(),
      estimate = numeric(),
      std_error = numeric(),
      z_value = numeric(),
      p_value = numeric(),
      model = character(),
      panel = character()
    ))
  }
  
  V <- vcov(model)
  se <- sqrt(diag(V)[names(est)])
  z <- unname(est) / se
  p <- 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  tibble(
    term = names(est),
    estimate = unname(est),
    std_error = unname(se),
    z_value = unname(z),
    p_value = unname(p),
    model = model_name,
    panel = panel
  )
}

make_row_label <- function(term) {
  case_when(
    str_detect(term, "^Q260") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q260"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q262") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q262"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q275R") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q275R"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q279") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q279"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q288R") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q288R"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q290_recode") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q290_recode"),
    TRUE ~ term
  )
}

add_blocks_and_labels <- function(df, ref_levels) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      block = case_when(
        str_detect(term, "^Q260") ~ paste0("Sex (ref: ", ref_levels$Q260, ")"),
        str_detect(term, "^Q262") ~ paste0("Age groups (ref: ", ref_levels$Q262, ")"),
        str_detect(term, "^Q275R") ~ paste0("Education (ref: ", ref_levels$Q275R, ")"),
        str_detect(term, "^Q279") ~ paste0("Employment status (ref: ", ref_levels$Q279, ")"),
        str_detect(term, "^Q288R") ~ paste0("Income (ref: ", ref_levels$Q288R, ")"),
        str_detect(term, "^Q290_recode") ~ paste0("Ethnolinguistic group (ref: ", ref_levels$Q290_recode, ")"),
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      row_label = make_row_label(term)
    )
}

make_wide_table <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(cell = mapply(format_cell, estimate, std_error, p_value)) |>
    select(block, row_label, model, cell) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = cell)
}

insert_block_rows <- function(df, model_names) {
  blocks <- unique(df$block)
  
  out <- lapply(blocks, function(b) {
    header <- tibble(
      block = b,
      row_label = b
    )
    
    for (m in model_names) {
      header[[m]] <- ""
    }
    
    bind_rows(
      header,
      df |> filter(block == b) |> select(-block)
    )
  })
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

make_fit_stats <- function(models, model_names = names(models)) {
  fit_stats <- tibble(
    row_label = c("AIC", "logLik", "cond.H")
  )
  
  for (m in model_names) {
    fit_stats[[m]] <- c(
      round(AIC(models[[m]]), 3),
      round(as.numeric(logLik(models[[m]])), 3),
      round(models[[m]]$cond.H, 3)
    )
  }
  
  fit_stats
}

make_blank_row <- function(model_names) {
  blank <- tibble(row_label = "")
  
  for (m in model_names) {
    blank[[m]] <- ""
  }
  
  blank
}

make_ft <- function(tab, title_text, block_names) {
  ft <- flextable(tab)
  
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, row_label = "")
  ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
  ft <- autofit(ft)
  
  ft <- align(ft, align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "body")
  
  block_rows <- which(tab$row_label %in% block_names)
  ft <- bold(ft, i = block_rows, bold = TRUE, part = "body")
  
  ft <- add_header_lines(ft, values = title_text)
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 9, part = "all")
  ft <- font(ft, fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")
  ft <- padding(ft, padding = 4, part = "all")
  
  ft
}

# =========================
# LOCATION TABLE
# =========================

loc_long <- bind_rows(lapply(names(models), function(nm) {
  extract_clm_part(models[[nm]], nm, part = "beta")
}))

loc_long <- add_blocks_and_labels(loc_long, ref_levels)

loc_wide <- make_wide_table(loc_long)

loc_table <- insert_block_rows(

)

fit_stats <- make_fit_stats(models) |>
```

#Marginal Effects Table
```{r}


# =========================
# CHOOSE YOUR FINAL MODEL
# =========================
best_model <- model_best   # change if needed

# =========================
# RECOVER FITTED MODEL FRAME
# =========================
mf <- droplevels(model.frame(best_model))

# =========================
# REFERENCE LEVELS
# =========================
ref_levels <- list(
  Q260 = levels(mf$Q260)[1],
  Q262 = levels(mf$Q262)[1],
  Q275R = levels(mf$Q275R)[1],
  Q279 = levels(mf$Q279)[1],
  Q288R = levels(mf$Q288R)[1],
  Q290_recode = levels(mf$Q290_recode)[1]
)

# =========================
# HELPERS
# =========================
p_fmt <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p)  ~ "",
    p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE      ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)
  )
}

make_row_label <- function(term) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(term, "^Q260") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q260"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q262") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q262"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q275R") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q275R"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q279") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q279"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q288R") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q288R"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q290_recode") ~ str_remove(term, "^Q290_recode"),
    TRUE ~ term
  )
}

make_block <- function(term, ref_levels) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(term, "^Q260") ~ paste0("Sex (ref: ", ref_levels$Q260, ")"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q262") ~ paste0("Age groups (ref: ", ref_levels$Q262, ")"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q275R") ~ paste0("Education (ref: ", ref_levels$Q275R, ")"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q279") ~ paste0("Employment status (ref: ", ref_levels$Q279, ")"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q288R") ~ paste0("Income (ref: ", ref_levels$Q288R, ")"),
    str_detect(term, "^Q290_recode") ~ paste0("Ethnolinguistic group (ref: ", ref_levels$Q290_recode, ")"),
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

extract_single_clm_part <- function(model, part = c("beta", "zeta"), ref_levels) {
  part <- match.arg(part)

  if (part == "beta") {
    est <- model$beta
    component <- "Location"
    extra_name <- "Odds ratio"
  } else {
    est <- model$zeta
    component <- "Log-scale"
    extra_name <- "Scale ratio"
  }

  if (length(est) == 0) {
    return(list(
      data = tibble(),
      component = component,
      extra_name = extra_name
    ))
  }

  V <- vcov(model)
  se <- sqrt(diag(V)[names(est)])
  z  <- unname(est) / se
  p  <- 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)

  out <- tibble(
    term = names(est),
    block = make_block(names(est), ref_levels),
    row_label = make_row_label(names(est)),
    estimate = unname(est),
    std_error = unname(se),
    z_value = unname(z),
    p_value = unname(p),
    extra = exp(unname(est))
  ) |>
    mutate(
      estimate = round(estimate, 3),
      std_error = round(std_error, 3),
      z_value = round(z_value, 3),
      p_value = p_fmt(p_value),
      extra = round(extra, 3)
    )

  list(
    data = out,
    component = component,
    extra_name = extra_name
  )
}

# FIXED VERSION: converts columns to character before bind_rows()
insert_block_rows_single <- function(df) {
  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      estimate = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(estimate)),
      std_error = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(std_error)),
      z_value = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(z_value)),
      extra = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(extra)),
      p_value = as.character(p_value)
    )

  blocks <- unique(df$block)

  out <- lapply(blocks, function(b) {
    header <- tibble(
      row_label = b,
      estimate = "",
      std_error = "",
      z_value = "",
      p_value = "",
      extra = ""
    )

    body <- df |>
      filter(block == b) |>
      select(row_label, estimate, std_error, z_value, p_value, extra)

    bind_rows(header, body)
  })

  bind_rows(out)
}

make_single_ft <- function(df, title_text, subtitle_text, extra_label) {
  block_names <- df$row_label[
    df$estimate == "" & df$std_error == "" & df$z_value == ""
  ]

  ft <- flextable(df)

  ft <- set_header_labels(
    ft,
    row_label = "",
    estimate = "Estimate",
    std_error = "SE",
    z_value = "z",
    p_value = "p",
    extra = extra_label
  )

  ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
  ft <- autofit(ft)

  ft <- align(ft, align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "body")

  ft <- bold(ft, i = which(df$row_label %in% block_names), bold = TRUE, part = "body")

  ft <- add_header_lines(ft, values = title_text)
  ft <- add_header_lines(ft, values = subtitle_text)

  ft
}

# =========================
# PANEL A: LOCATION COEFFICIENTS
# =========================
loc_obj <- extract_single_clm_part(best_model, part = "beta", ref_levels = ref_levels)
loc_tab <- insert_block_rows_single(loc_obj$data)

ft_loc <- make_single_ft(

ft_loc

    scale_tab,
    title_text = "Table X. Final cumulative link model",
    subtitle_text = "Panel B. Log-scale coefficients",
    extra_label = scale_obj$extra_name
  )

  ft_scale
}

# =========================
```

```{r}
# helper: safely extract probability matrix from predict()
get_prob_mat <- function(pred_obj) {
  if (is.list(pred_obj) && "fit" %in% names(pred_obj)) {
    as.data.frame(pred_obj$fit)
  } else {
    as.data.frame(pred_obj)
  }
}

# for each education-income combination:
# set Q275R and Q288R to that combo for every row in the sample,
# predict probabilities row by row,
# then average the probabilities across rows
prob_marginal <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(grid_ei)), function(i) {

  edu_i <- grid_ei$Q275R[i]
  inc_i <- grid_ei$Q288R[i]

  newdata_i <- pred_base |>
    mutate(
      Q275R = factor(edu_i, levels = levels(mf$Q275R)),
      Q288R = factor(inc_i, levels = levels(mf$Q288R))
    )

  pr_i <- predict(mod, newdata = newdata_i, type = "prob")
  prob_i <- get_prob_mat(pr_i)

  # average predicted probabilities over all rows
  avg_prob <- colMeans(prob_i)

  tibble(
    Q275R = edu_i,
    Q288R = inc_i,
    Q106_cat = names(avg_prob),
    prob = as.numeric(avg_prob)
  )
})

# make sure category labels are 1:10 in order
prob_marginal <- prob_marginal |>
  mutate(
    Q106_cat = factor(Q106_cat, levels = as.character(1:10)),
    Q275R = factor(Q275R, levels = levels(mf$Q275R)),
    Q288R = factor(Q288R, levels = levels(mf$Q288R))
  )

# collapse into low / middle / high ranges
collapse_marginal <- prob_marginal |>
  mutate(
    cat_num = as.integer(as.character(Q106_cat)),
    band = case_when(
      cat_num <= 3 ~ "Low (1–3)",
      cat_num <= 7 ~ "Middle (4–7)",
      TRUE         ~ "High (8–10)"
    ),
    band = factor(
      band,
      levels = c("Low (1–3)", "Middle (4–7)", "High (8–10)")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Q275R, Q288R, band) |>
  summarise(prob = sum(prob), .groups = "drop")

# plot
pred_plot_educ_income <- ggplot(collapse_marginal,
       aes(x = Q275R, y = prob, color = Q288R, group = Q288R)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ band, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 0.8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Collapsed predicted probabilities of Q106",
    subtitle = "Marginal predictions by education and income group",
    x = "Education",
    y = "Predicted probability",
    color = "Income group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

pred_plot_educ_income

ggsave(
  filename = "pred_plot_educ_income.png",
  plot = pred_plot_educ_income,
  width = 10,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```

#IncomexEmployment
```{r}

library(purrr)


# use your retained final model
mod <- model_best   # replace if needed

# actual estimation sample used by the model
mf <- droplevels(model.frame(mod))

# predictors only
pred_base <- mf |>
  select(-Q106)

# outcome levels
y_levels <- levels(mf$Q106)

# -------------------------
# 1. Collapse employment categories for plotting
# -------------------------
collapse_q279 <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x %in% c("Full time (30 hours a week or more)",
             "Part time (less than 30 hours a week)") ~ "Employed",
    x == "Self employed" ~ "Self-employed",
    x == "Unemployed" ~ "Unemployed",
    x == "Housewife not otherwise employed" ~ "Homemaker",
    x == "Retired/pensioned" ~ "Retired/pensioned",
    x == "Student" ~ "Student",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

# map original Q279 levels to collapsed groups
q279_map <- tibble(
  Q279 = levels(mf$Q279),
  emp_collapsed = collapse_q279(levels(mf$Q279))
)

# weights of original Q279 levels within each collapsed group
# based on the estimation sample
q279_weights <- mf |>
  count(Q279) |>
  left_join(q279_map, by = "Q279") |>
  group_by(emp_collapsed) |>
  mutate(weight = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

# order of collapsed employment groups in the plot
emp_levels <- c("Employed", "Self-employed", "Unemployed",
                "Homemaker", "Retired/pensioned","Student", "Other")

# all collapsed employment × income combinations
grid_ei <- expand.grid(
  emp_collapsed = emp_levels,
  Q288R = levels(mf$Q288R),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# -------------------------
# 2. Helper to safely extract probability matrix
# -------------------------
get_prob_mat <- function(pred_obj, y_levels) {
  prob_mat <- if (is.list(pred_obj) && !is.null(pred_obj$fit)) {
    pred_obj$fit
  } else {
    pred_obj
  }

  prob_mat <- as.data.frame(prob_mat)

  if (ncol(prob_mat) != length(y_levels)) {
    stop("Prediction output does not have one column per Q106 category.")
  }

  colnames(prob_mat) <- y_levels
  prob_mat
}

# -------------------------
# 3. Marginal predictions for collapsed employment × income
# -------------------------
prob_emp_income <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(grid_ei)), function(i) {

  emp_i <- grid_ei$emp_collapsed[i]
  inc_i <- grid_ei$Q288R[i]

  # original Q279 levels inside this collapsed employment group
  q279_sub <- q279_weights |>
    filter(emp_collapsed == emp_i)

  # weighted average across original Q279 levels within this collapsed group
  avg_prob_i <- purrr::map2_dfr(q279_sub$Q279, q279_sub$weight, function(q279_level, w) {

    newdata_i <- pred_base |>
      mutate(
        Q279 = factor(q279_level, levels = levels(mf$Q279)),
        Q288R = factor(inc_i, levels = levels(mf$Q288R))
      )

    pr_i <- predict(mod, newdata = newdata_i, type = "prob")
    prob_i <- get_prob_mat(pr_i, y_levels)

    tibble(
      Q106_cat = y_levels,
      prob = colMeans(prob_i) * w
    )
  }) |>
    group_by(Q106_cat) |>
    summarise(prob = sum(prob), .groups = "drop")

  tibble(
    emp_collapsed = emp_i,
    Q288R = inc_i,
    Q106_cat = avg_prob_i$Q106_cat,
    prob = avg_prob_i$prob
  )
})

# ensure correct ordering
prob_emp_income <- prob_emp_income |>
  mutate(
    emp_collapsed = factor(emp_collapsed, levels = emp_levels),
    Q288R = factor(Q288R, levels = levels(mf$Q288R)),
    Q106_cat = factor(Q106_cat, levels = as.character(1:10))
  )

# -------------------------
# 4. Collapse Q106 into Low / Middle / High
# -------------------------
collapse_emp_income <- prob_emp_income |>
  mutate(
    cat_num = as.integer(as.character(Q106_cat)),
    band = case_when(
      cat_num <= 3 ~ "Low (1–3)",
      cat_num <= 7 ~ "Middle (4–7)",
      TRUE         ~ "High (8–10)"
    ),
    band = factor(
      band,
      levels = c("Low (1–3)", "Middle (4–7)", "High (8–10)")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(emp_collapsed, Q288R, band) |>
  summarise(prob = sum(prob), .groups = "drop")

# -------------------------
# 5. Plot
# -------------------------
ggplot(
  collapse_emp_income,
  aes(x = emp_collapsed, y = prob, color = Q288R, group = Q288R)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ band, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Collapsed predicted probabilities of Q106",
    subtitle = "Marginal predictions by employment status and income group",
    x = "Employment status",
    y = "Predicted probability",
    color = "Income group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
loc_df <- data.frame(
  term = names(model_best$beta),
  estimate = unname(model_best$beta),
  se = sqrt(diag(vcov(model_best)))[names(model_best$beta)]
) |>
  mutate(
    part = "Location",
    lower = estimate - 1.96 * se,
    upper = estimate + 1.96 * se
  )

scale_df <- data.frame(
  term = names(model_best$zeta),
  estimate = unname(model_best$zeta),
  se = sqrt(diag(vcov(model_best)))[names(model_best$zeta)]
) |>
  mutate(
    part = "Log-scale",
    lower = estimate - 1.96 * se,
    upper = estimate + 1.96 * se
  )

coef_df <- bind_rows(loc_df, scale_df)

ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(term, estimate))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), height = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ part, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Coefficient plot for model_D_S4",
    x = "Estimate (95% CI)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
WVS2 <- droplevels(model.frame(model_best))

# Extract model components
alpha <- model_best$alpha   # thresholds
beta  <- model_best$beta    # location coefficients
zeta  <- model_best$zeta    # scale coefficients

# Helper: return 0 if coefficient is the reference category
get_coef <- function(coefs, name) {
  if (name %in% names(coefs)) coefs[name] else 0
}

# Use your actual factor levels
edu_levels <- levels(WVS2$Q275R)
inc_levels <- levels(WVS2$Q288R)

# Create education-income combinations
profiles <- expand.grid(
  Q275R = edu_levels,
  Q288R = inc_levels
)

# Compute location and scale for each profile
profiles <- profiles |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    location =
      get_coef(beta, paste0("Q275R", Q275R)) +
      get_coef(beta, paste0("Q288R", Q288R)),

    log_scale =
      get_coef(zeta, paste0("Q275R", Q275R)) +
      get_coef(zeta, paste0("Q288R", Q288R)),

    scale = exp(log_scale)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

profiles
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------
# 1. Parameters
# ----------------------------

# Option A: use artificial/example thresholds
#theta <- seq(-2.2, 2.2, length.out = 9)

# Option B: use your actual clm thresholds instead
 theta <- as.numeric(model_best$alpha)

mu <- 0
sigma <- 1

x <- seq(min(theta) - 2, max(theta) + 2, length.out = 4000)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Create density data
# ----------------------------

df <- tibble(
  x = x,
  density = dlogis(x, location = mu, scale = sigma)
) |>
  mutate(
    category = cut(
      x,
      breaks = c(-Inf, theta, Inf),
      labels = paste0("Y = ", 1:10),
      right = TRUE
    )
  )
# ----------------------------
# 3. Threshold labels
# ----------------------------

theta_df <- tibble(
  theta = theta,
  label = paste0("theta[", 1:9, "]")
)

# ----------------------------
# 4. Plot
# ----------------------------

ggplot(df, aes(x = x)) +
  geom_area(
    aes(y = density, fill = category),
    alpha = 0.85,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(y = density), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = theta,
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = theta,
    y = -0.015,
    label = paste0("theta[", 1:9, "]"),
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = min(x),
    xend = max(x),
    y = 0,
    yend = 0,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.18, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Latent-variable illustration for a 10-level ordinal response",
    subtitle = "Thresholds divide the latent continuum into observed Q106 categories",
    x = "Latent attitude toward income equality vs individual incentives",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Observed category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
  )
```

#summary stat table
```{r}


#mf <- droplevels(model.frame(model_best))

mf <- WVS[,c("Q106", "Q260", "Q262", "Q273","Q275R", "Q279", "Q286","Q287","Q288R","Q290_recode")]

vars <- c(
  "Q106", "Q260", "Q262", "Q273", "Q275R",
  "Q279", "Q286", "Q287", "Q288R", "Q290_recode"
)

var_labels <- c(
  Q106 = "Q106: Perception of income equality",
  Q260 = "Q260: Sex",
  Q262 = "Q262: Age group",
  Q273 = "Q273: Marital status",
  Q275R = "Q275R: Educational attainment",
  Q279 = "Q279: Employment status",
  Q286 = "Q286: Family savings during past year",
  Q287 = "Q287: Social class (subjective)",
  Q288R = "Q288R: Income group",
  Q290_recode = "Q290_recode: Ethnolinguistic group"
)

desc_table <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
  
  total_n <- sum(!is.na(mf[[v]]))
  missing_n <- sum(is.na(mf[[v]]))
  
  var_label_with_n <- paste0(
    var_labels[[v]],
    " (n=", format(total_n, big.mark = ","),
    ", missing=", format(missing_n, big.mark = ","),
    ")"
  )
  
  mf |>
    count(.data[[v]], name = "Frequency") |>
    mutate(
      Variable = var_label_with_n,
      Category = ifelse(is.na(.data[[v]]), "Missing", as.character(.data[[v]])),
      Percent = Frequency / total_n * 100
    ) |>
    filter(Category != "Missing") |>
    select(Variable, Category, Frequency, Percent)
}) |>
  mutate(
    Frequency = format(Frequency, big.mark = ","),
    Percent = paste0(round(Percent, 1), "%")
  )

# Publication-ready Word table
ft_desc <- desc_table |>
  flextable() |>
  set_header_labels(
    Variable = "Variable Code and Label",
    Category = "Category / Sub-variable",
    Frequency = "Frequency",
    Percent = "Percent"
  ) |>
  merge_v(j = "Variable") |>          # makes first column appear once
  valign(j = "Variable", valign = "top") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  align(align = "center", part = "header") |>
  align(j = c("Frequency", "Percent"), align = "center", part = "body") |>
  align(j = c("Variable", "Category"), align = "left", part = "body") |>
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") |>
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") |>
  padding(padding = 4, part = "all") |>
  autofit()

ft_desc

save_as_docx(
  "Table 1. Descriptive Statistics of Variables Included in the Analysis" = ft_desc,
  path = "descriptive_statistics.docx"
)
```
